purpose: Diagnostic audit of every v6-held candidate; not a runtime rule or allowlist.

method.stableIdJoin: Mechanical audit candidateId joined with frozen run-5 candidate, exact emitter chunk, source bundle and v6 receipt.
method.navigationRule: Source row is assigned only when an exact candidate row quote or exact candidate subject plus value uniquely identifies a source zone inside the emitter chunk. Candidate row/table metadata is not source proof; unresolved mappings contain no invented PDF page or quote.
method.sourceMatching: Original candidate/OCR strings are preserved. No OCR correction or model inference.
method.offsets: Absolute UTF-16 code-unit offsets in frozen source range; source ranges are BMP-only. Every output quote was checked against the exact source-range slice.
method.pdfReview: Unmodified PDF renders cited by path; visual findings are diagnostic and do not alter OCR.
method.causalInterpretation: Primary causes form a mutually exclusive cross-tab. Extraction count includes duplicate model emissions; projection-domain rows are representation-induced binding false negatives, not semantic quality or validator-correctness findings. OCR/layout and ambiguous groups are separately labeled. A validator hold alone is not a validator defect.

globalFindings.finding: Frozen Paddle places December in header grid cell 6 while final values are data cell 7. In this source-supported example, the OCR header/value boxes overlap exactly in x. This can explain a false negative only when candidate subject/value fields are otherwise source-correct; wrong or incomplete fields remain extraction causes.
